rounds.text: Samtex Fashions Ltd presents a precarious financial profile characterized by extreme insolvency risks and a lack of shareholder value creation. The company is burdened by massive borrowings of Rs 563.69 Cr, which have increased year-over-year [E25], while its current ratio of 0.01x indicates that current liabilities vastly exceed current assets [E24]. This debt load is compounded by a low interest coverage ratio [E33] and negative operating and free cash flows of Rs -0.15 Cr as of March 2026 [E22, E23]. Furthermore, the company has failed to generate meaningful returns for investors, evidenced by a 10-year compounded share price growth of -18% and a 1-year decline of 44% [E15, E18]. The business also faces potential future liabilities of Rs 24.1 Cr [E34], which further threatens its already fragile balance sheet. Conceded: [E13, E36, E37, E38, E39] show recent improvements in profit growth and earnings acceleration. Despite these recent metrics, the long-term trend of negative ROCE [E9, E11] and the absence of dividends [E3] suggest that the company remains fundamentally challenged.
